subject: TaRapedia revision boundary for rebuilt boot camp and supporting cover rule
method: Read the named revision wikitext using the TaRapedia MediaWiki API action=parse oldid endpoint; archived exact wikitext snapshots outside Git. Revision timestamps came from action=query prop=revisions.

findings.source_location: wikitext line 9 and subsequent Portals/Missions sections
findings.finding: The page itself warns that the camp had changed and its contents need updating. Its Elvers/Burba/Constant route must not seed the final-live rebuilt tutorial.
The last recorded revision predates the August 2008 tutorial rebuild and identifies Commander Elvers as giver. Do not treat its mission text, rewards or objective order as final-live tutorial data.
The Captain Burba level-four bypass belongs to the earlier camp. The final-live client has its own skip prompt; this old mission cannot establish rebuilt-camp skip rewards or routing.

The post-rebuild page describes reduced weapon damage against a partially covered target. It supports the presence of cover damage reduction but gives no final-live sampling algorithm, multiplier or packet semantics.

limits: Wiki revision date does not prove the described gameplay remained unchanged through shutdown. Original client data and final-week footage remain stronger evidence. The four snapshots above are research sources, not gameplay server captures.
